title: Women Entering Perimenopause -  Beauty, Hormones & Real Talk with Anita Maestas
description:
🎙️ Episode 10: The Truth About Aging Gracefully, Perimenopause, and Beauty | Working Moms Podcast

In this candid and hilarious episode, hosts Gloria and Marissa are joined by special guest Anita Maestes — real estate broker, gym owner, farm mama, and longtime best friend — for a real conversation about what it's really like to age as a working mom.

We’re diving deep into the beauty changes, hormonal shifts, and identity transformations that come with perimenopause (aka #Perio), parenting teens, and letting go of outdated beauty standards.

💬 Topics We Cover in This Episode:

What is perimenopause and why aren’t we talking about it?
Beauty hacks that actually work after 30
The battle with chin hairs, hot flashes, and frizzy hair
Embracing holistic beauty vs. botox and fillers
Balancing single parenting, career, and self-care
The emotional shift of aging and identity after motherhood

Whether you're in your 30s, 40s, or beyond — this episode will make you laugh, relate, and feel empowered in your skin. It’s everything you talk about with your best friend… plus a few confessions you didn’t expect.

👯‍♀️Subscribe for more real conversations on motherhood, mental health, career, and womanhood every week.
